difficulty_reason: The proof has two halves: the forward implication is the same-chapter lemma that stalks of flat modules are flat (lemma-stalk-flat); for the converse it combines the identity (\mathcal{F} \otimes \mathcal{G})_p = \mathcal{F}_p \otimes_{\mathcal{O}_p} \mathcal{G}_p (stalks commute with tensor, via p^{-1}) with the lemma that exactness is checked on stalks for a conservative family of points, so that exactness of \mathcal{F} \otimes - is detected at every stalk, where it is exactly flatness of \mathcal{F}_p. The transport of flatness through the stalk-tensor identity is the substance.
